purpose: Compact AI-to-engine contract. The AI supplies factual content and creative intent; the engine generates schema, layout, animation, runtime integration, and standalone HTML.

intakePolicy.completion: Set intake.status to complete after answers, or bypassed only on explicit user instruction.

compactRequest.title: string
compactRequest.images: optional local or web image descriptors
compactRequest.assetPolicy: optional remote=allow|warn|deny, offlineRequired boolean, and embedLocal boolean
compactRequest.uiLibraries: optional auto|native|recipe|vendor policy, allow/deny lists, capability needs, and maximum library count

contentPolicy: The engine inventories every supplied fact, checks semantic capacity, and does not silently pad thin requests. Use generation.contentPolicy=strict to reject rather than shorten.
assetPolicy: Local assets are root-contained and embedded by default. Use assetPolicy.offlineRequired=true or remote=deny to reject remote and volatile dependencies.
tokenPolicy: Never regenerate runtime code, CSS, component HTML, animation controllers, or verbose schema boilerplate. Author only the compact factual request. Generated-code avoidance is not a measured token saving.
resolution: Supported intake.answers values are applied by IntakeResolver. Conflicts reject generation. Free-text content requirements remain AI responsibilities.
